hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.png|*.PNG|*.jpg|*.JPG|*.jpeg|*.JPEG|*.gif|*.GIF|*.webp|*.WEBP) sz=$(stat -c%s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$sz" -gt 204800 ]; then jq -n --arg path "$f" --arg sz "$sz" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Image \($path) is \($sz) bytes (>200KB). Reading binary images saturates context. Use Bash with `identify`/`file`/`stat` for metadata, or delegate visual work to an Explore subagent.")}}'; fi;; esac
